name: @vap/cssh
description: Connect to a code-server terminal from the command line or Node.js

scripts.build: tsc --strict --target ES2022 --module commonjs --esModuleInterop --declaration --outDir dist CodeServerClient.ts config.ts shell.ts && node -e "require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/shell.js', 0o755)"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module commonjs --esModuleInterop CodeServerClient.ts CodeServerClient.test.ts config.ts shell.ts
